statement: Complete exact affine finite-subgroup and partial-section catalogues for punctured tori with 1,2,3,4 punctures: 13,40,38,115 conjugacy classes. Every class has explicit rational affine matrices, punctures, all splitting classes and inclusions, Phi, stabilizers, centralizers and multipliers.
where_proved: work/part_b/b27.tex; work/part_b/code/catalogue_tori.py and four CSV/JSON catalogues
manuscript_passages: Part B(f) of the task; no further manuscript assertion
notes: All hyperbolic torus types in 2g+nu<=6 are covered. Exhaustiveness: translation order<=nu<=4; all13 integral point groups; exact cocycles and affine conjugacy; all decorated quotient strata. Mesh144 has proved denominator bound. Independent type(1,1) amalgam check passes. No higher-genus completeness is claimed here.
